prompt: Create a cinematic luxury editorial studio portrait of a young Black man seated sideways on a dark wooden chair with an X-shaped backrest, turned slightly toward the camera. He wears a dark chocolate brown crewneck sweatshirt and matching dark pants, black rectangular designer sunglasses, and a silver metal wristwatch with a black dial on his left wrist. His hands are clasped together near his chin in a calm, confident pose, elbows bent, with a composed serious expression. Use a tight three-quarter portrait crop from upper thighs to head, with the chair visible on the right side and the subject centered slightly right. Hair is short, neat, and textured; skin detail is realistic and polished. Set the scene against a seamless deep charcoal black studio backdrop with no text or props beyond the chair. Lighting should feel like a high-end fashion shoot: soft directional key light from upper front-left, gentle falloff, subtle highlights on the cheekbones, watch, sunglasses, and wood grain, deep shadows, rich contrast, warm natural skin tones, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic photography, premium editorial mood, 4:5 vertical aspect ratio.

promptZh: 创作一张电影感奢华编辑风格影棚肖像，主体为 一位年轻黑人男性，侧身坐在带有 X 型靠背的深色木椅上，身体略微转向镜头。他身穿 一件深巧克力棕色圆领卫衣和配套深色长裤，佩戴黑色长方形设计师太阳镜，左手腕佩戴一块黑色表盘的银色金属腕表。他双手交叠靠近下巴，姿态沉稳自信，手肘弯曲，表情从容严肃。采用从大腿上部到头部的紧凑四分之三肖像构图，椅子位于右侧，主体略微偏右居中。发型短促、整洁且富有质感；皮肤细节真实且精致。场景设置在无缝的 深炭黑色 影棚背景前，除椅子外无任何文字或道具。灯光应呈现高端时尚拍摄质感：来自左前方上方的柔和主光，光线平滑过渡，颧骨、腕表、太阳镜和木纹上有细腻的高光，阴影深邃，对比度丰富，自然的暖色调皮肤，浅景深，超写实摄影，高级编辑氛围，4:5 垂直纵横比。
